## Rule (confirmed by demos and solved test)
A straight line of color 2 is a divider. Find the colored object (which may be a single cell or an irregular shape) on either side of it. If the object is already adjacent to the divider, leave it in place and draw the 8-line immediately outside its far edge.

- Vertical divider: shift object horizontally; add a full-height vertical 8-line beyond the object.
- Horizontal divider: shift object vertically; add a full-width horizontal 8-line beyond the object.

- Demo 1: 5x8, vertical divider at column 2 (0-based); the color-4 object at columns 3–4 was already adjacent on the right side. Output keeps it in place and draws full-height color 8 at column 5, its far/outside edge.
